problem_description: In scsi_disk_emulate_write_same(), reading data from inbuf using the mutable s->qdev.blocksize instead of the allocated request buffer size r->buflen causes an out-of-bounds heap read when a guest concurrently increases the sector size via MODE SELECT.

In hw/arm/ax3000-soc.c, the TypeInfo definition for TYPE_AX3000_SOC omits .class_size, causing type_initialize() to allocate only the parent SysBusDeviceClass size and leading ax3000_class_init() to overwrite adjacent heap memory when setting sc->num_cpus.

In loongarch_dintc_mem_write(), the guest-controlled cpu_num extracted from the MMIO write address is not validated against s->num_cpu, causing an out-of-bounds CPU lookup and NULL pointer dereference in async_run_on_cpu().

In iso_get_file_size(), decrementing level when dir_rem[level] reaches zero allows level to become -1, causing an out-of-bounds array read of sec_loc[-1] and passing a garbage block number to virtio_read().

In the s390-ccw boot firmware, defining MAX_BOOT_ENTRIES as 31 conflates the maximum entry index with the total entry count, preventing valid boot menu entry 31 from being selected when booting with loadparm.

In vga_draw_graphic(), mismatched units in last_width between text mode (characters) and graphics mode (pixels) allow a graphics-to-text-to-graphics transition to bypass panning_buf reallocation, causing a heap buffer overflow during scanline drawing.

In virtio-gpu, virtio_gpu_resource_create_blob() and virtio_gpu_resource_attach_backing() fail to validate that the backing I/O vector is at least as large as the guest-specified blob_size, allowing subsequent display refreshes to read beyond allocated host memory.

In cxl_doe_cdat_rsp(), the guest-controlled entry_handle is not bounds-checked against cdat->entry_len before indexing cdat->entry, leading to out-of-bounds heap reads and potential buffer overflows when copying table data into the response mailbox.
In menu_get_zipl_boot_index(), using strlen() without buffer bounds checking on stage-2 image data that may lack null termination causes out-of-bounds memory reads beyond the menu buffer.

In port_tx_write(), the guest-controlled transmit packet size tx_len is not checked against the device buffer capacity BUFSZ_MAX, allowing oversized packets to trigger out-of-bounds reads beyond the device RAM in qemu_send_packet().

In virtio_blk_handle_scsi(), writing SCSI error status into the second-to-last input segment without checking that its buffer length is at least sizeof(struct virtio_scsi_inhdr) causes a heap buffer overflow when the segment is backed by a 1-byte bounce buffer.

In virtio_net_rss_post_load(), restoring an invalid or zero indirections_len from a migration stream bypasses validation checks, leaving the indirection table unallocated and causing a NULL pointer dereference in virtio_net_process_rss().

In virtio_blk_handle_zone_report(), allocating a zone report buffer sized directly from the guest-supplied nr_zones without an upper bound causes an out-of-memory condition and process abort in g_malloc().
In get_guest_rtc_ns(), multiplying the 64-bit s->base_rtc value by NANOSECONDS_PER_SECOND causes an integer overflow, resulting in backward time jumps and kernel soft lockups in the guest.

In virtio_pmem_unrealize(), destroying the VirtIOPMEM device without waiting for in-flight thread pool fsync requests causes done_cb() to dereference the freed device pointer when asynchronous tasks complete.

In virtio_9p_device_unrealize(), failing to cancel and drain in-flight 9p PDUs via v9fs_reset() prior to destroying the device allows worker threads to dereference already-freed filesystem state when hot-unplugging.
In xen_9pfs_disconnect(), destroying Xen9pfsRing structures without canceling active PDUs causes a use-after-free in xen_9pfs_push_and_notify() when worker threads complete filesystem operations.
In ivshmem_exit(), deallocating s->peers while chardev handlers remain registered allows incoming server messages to dereference the dangling pointer in process_msg_connect().

In ufs_lu_unrealize(), explicitly invoking object_unref() on the borrowed lu->scsi_dev pointer causes a double free and use-after-free when the parent bus subsequently drops its reference during device ejection.

In v9fs_co_readdir_many(), executing directory reads in a worker thread without holding the rename lock allows a concurrent rename request to free and replace the FID path string, causing a heap use-after-free in do_readdir_many().
In cpr_exec_cb(), accessing argv[0] in error_setg_errno() after deallocating argv with g_strfreev() causes a use-after-free whenever execvp() fails.

In migrate_params_test_apply(), clearing unprovided TLS option pointers in the temporary parameters structure causes migrate_params_check() to encounter NULL pointers and crash with a segmentation fault during option validation.

In get_relocated_path(), calculating the write cursor pointer before resizing the GString with g_string_set_size() causes writes to a dangling pointer when the string buffer is reallocated on Windows.

In migration_ioc_shutdown_gracefully(), declaring local_err with g_autoptr(Error) while passing it to warn_reportf_err() results in a double free when the automatic cleanup handler executes at function exit.
In virtio_scsi_handle_cmd_vq(), dropping only a single reference on prepared SCSI requests when cleaning up after a bad command leaks the second reference and causes unbounded host memory exhaustion.

In dbus_display_console_dispose(), omitting the removal of mouse_mode_notifier leaves a dangling pointer registered on the global notifier list, causing a use-after-free when a mouse mode transition occurs.
In cxl_fmws_direct_passthrough_setup(), direct_mr_name is declared with g_autofree without NULL initialization, causing g_free() to deallocate uninitialized stack memory if an early return executes.
In replay_find_nearest_snapshot(), when bdrv_snapshot_list() returns a negative error code, sn_tab remains uninitialized and is passed to g_free(), corrupting the heap and crashing the process.
In ufs_emulate_report_luns(), bytes 4 through 7 of the REPORT LUNS response header are left uninitialized before being DMA-transferred to guest memory, leaking host stack data.

In colo_compare_finalize(), attempting to destroy event_mtx and dereference s->iothread on an object whose initialization was not completed causes NULL pointer dereferences and mutex assertion crashes.

In io/net-listener.c, initializing listener->lock in qio_net_listener_new() rather than instance_init causes qio_net_listener_finalize() to abort when destroying the uninitialized mutex on objects created directly via object_new().

In target/s390x/tcg/translate.c, op_stck() sets the condition code before executing the memory store, discarding lazy CC calculations and causing an assertion failure in cc_calc_addu() when the store faults.

In linux-user/sh4/signal.c, setup_sigcontext() and restore_sigcontext() directly copy env->sr without using cpu_read_sr() and cpu_write_sr(), losing the T, M, and Q condition flags across signal delivery.

In tpm_tis_sysbus_initfn(), calling memory_region_init_ram_device_ptr() and memory_region_init_io() during device instance initialization rather than realization triggers assertion failures in the memory subsystem when introspecting the device.

In monitor/monitor.c, delaying the initialization of monitor_lock until monitor_init_globals() causes QEMU to abort when accessing the uninitialized mutex if error_report() invokes monitor_cur() during early startup.

In target/riscv/cpu_bits.h, the SEED_OPST_* macros expand to signed integer constants with bit 31 set, causing sign-extension when cast to target_ulong and corrupting the upper 32 bits of the seed CSR on RV64.

In bdrv_dirty_bitmap_serialization_coverage(), shifting the 32-bit signed integer serialized_chunk_size left by 3 bits overflows when the chunk size is 256 MiB or greater, causing out-of-bounds memory writes during bitmap deserialization.
In nvme_set_feature_fdp_events(), shifting the 32-bit integer literal 1 by values from nvme_fdp_evf_shifts causes an integer overflow when constructing the 64-bit event_mask.
In walk_directory(), evaluating (1 << w) using 32-bit signed arithmetic causes an integer overflow when w is 31 or greater, corrupting the generation of adjacent TLB page entries.
In audio_init(), multiplying dev->timer_period by SCALE_US using 32-bit arithmetic causes an integer overflow before widening to int64_t for timer periods exceeding ~4.3 seconds.

In target/s390x/tcg/int_helper.c, HELPER(divs32)() performs 64-bit signed division without checking for INT64_MIN / -1, causing host integer division overflow and terminating QEMU with SIGFPE on trapping architectures.
In include/qemu/host-utils.h, ssub32_saturate() and ssub64_saturate() are declared to return bool instead of signed integers and clamp to the opposite saturation boundary upon overflow.

In virtio_gpu_do_set_scanout(), failing to verify that pixman_image_create_bits() returns a non-NULL pointer causes an immediate NULL pointer dereference when a guest provides an invalid scanout stride.
In riscv_imsic_reset_enter(), unconditionally clearing emulated state arrays causes a NULL pointer dereference during machine reset when the IMSIC is managed by a KVM in-kernel irqchip.
In riscv_aplic_reset_enter(), zeroing emulated interrupt state arrays unconditionally causes a NULL pointer dereference during system reset when APLIC is backed by a KVM in-kernel irqchip.

In target/riscv/csr.c, rmw_xireg_aia() and rmw_xtopei() unconditionally dereference the val pointer, causing a host segmentation fault when a guest executes write-only instructions to the xireg or xtopei CSRs.

In apic_common_set_id(), dereferencing s->cpu to inspect x2APIC features when setting an APIC ID greater than or equal to 255 causes a NULL pointer dereference if the APIC device is not yet attached to a CPU.
In prop_pxb_uid_get(), invoking pci_bus_num() on an unrealized PXB bus whose parent_dev pointer is NULL causes an unconditional NULL pointer dereference.
In hw/ide/ahci.c, stopping and restarting the AHCI command engine without canceling in-flight buffered ATAPI reads causes subsequent completion callbacks to dereference a cleared cur_cmd pointer.
In multifd_recv_terminate_threads(), exiting early when thread termination is already in progress omits freeing the provided err parameter, leaking the Error object.

In riscv_trigger_unrealize(), calling timer_del() instead of timer_free() removes the per-trigger timers from the active list without deallocating them, leaking QEMUTimer objects during CPU unrealization.
In nvme_copy_done(), the buffer allocated for iocb->ranges is not deallocated when destroying the copy request control block, leaking heap memory upon command completion.
In hw/hexagon/virt.c, calling create_fdt() unconditionally during virt_instance_init() allocates a 1MB device tree blob that is never freed when machine objects are inspected without being realized.
In virtio_gpu_base_device_realize(), adding a migration blocker before validating output display parameters leaks the migration blocker if configuration validation subsequently fails.
In target/i386/sev.c, snp_populate_metadata_pages() and sev_inject_launch_secret() omit calling memory_region_unref() on the MemoryRegion pointer returned by gpa2hva(), leaking object references.
In hw/arm/virt.c, virt_instance_finalize() fails to invoke g_ptr_array_free() on vms->smmuv3_devices, leaking the GPtrArray upon machine destruction.

In target/i386/sev.c, SEV object types omit instance_finalize functions and overwrite string property fields without deallocating the previous values, leaking heap memory upon property updates and object destruction.

In net/filter.c, netfilter_set_netdev_id() and netfilter_set_position() overwrite existing string property values with g_strdup() without freeing previous allocations, leaking memory on property updates.
In s390_pci_end_dma_count(), removing an S390PCIDMACount element from s->zpci_dma_limit when its user count reaches zero omits calling g_free(), leaking the tracking structure.
In exit_with_parent_loop(), the background monitoring thread exits without closing fd on non-Linux platforms, leaking the open pipe file descriptor.
In hw/loongarch/virt.c, the virt machine type omits an instance_finalize handler, leaking unrealized flash device objects and duplicated OEM string buffers when the machine object is destroyed.

In thread_pool_adjust_max_threads_to_work(), setting the maximum thread count to pool->cur_work allows the limit to drop to zero, causing queued tasks to hang indefinitely when work is submitted while no idle threads exist.

In qcow2_co_pwrite_zeroes(), checking cluster allocation status before waiting for in-flight allocating write dependencies allows a racing write to finish during the subsequent zeroize yield, causing zero_in_l2_slice() to discard the newly written data.
In hw/ide/core.c, holding the block-backend in-flight counter across chained TRIM discard requests causes a mutual deadlock when a block drain or IDE reset waits for in-flight requests to complete.

In migration_iteration_run(), waiting indefinitely on postcopy_package_loaded_event in POSTCOPY_DEVICE state causes the migration thread to hang if network failure or a destination crash prevents receipt of the pong acknowledgment.
In nfs_co_generic_cb(), calling aio_co_wake() directly re-enters the request coroutine while holding the NFS mutex, causing a deadlock if the coroutine immediately submits a subsequent request.
In curl_multi_check_completion(), breaking out of the loop after processing a single completed transfer leaves other finished transfers unhandled, causing concurrent I/O operations to hang.

In monitor_qapi_event_queue_no_reenter(), applying rate limiting to BLOCK_IO_ERROR events when action="stop" causes QEMU to suppress the error event, leaving management tools unaware of why the VM paused.
In helper_csrwr_estat(), writing software interrupt bits to CSR_ESTAT.IS[1:0] in TCG mode fails to update CPU_INTERRUPT_HARD, preventing pending software interrupts from raising exceptions.

In sclp_service_call(), re-reading the SCCB header from guest memory after validating its length creates a race condition where a concurrent vCPU can overwrite the length, leading to buffer inconsistency and memory corruption.

In aio_dispatch_handler(), executing node->io_poll_ready() while the poll handler remains registered in ctx->poll_aio_handlers allows nested aio_poll() calls to re-trigger the same handler, causing infinite recursion and stack exhaustion.

In hw/vfio/pci.c, invoking accel_irqchip_begin_route_changes() without checking accel_msi_via_irqfd_enabled() causes a fatal process abort when running VFIO PCI devices under TCG emulation without an accelerator irqchip.
In sparc64_set_context(), updating the signal mask without verifying the return value of block_signals() allows signals that are pending and newly blocked to be dropped without delivery.
In ide_reset(), requiring s->reset_reverts to be set before restoring default CHS parameters causes custom drive geometries configured by a guest to persist across hardware and machine resets.

In get_S2prot_indirect(), checking SCR_PIEN without verifying that ARM_FEATURE_EL3 is implemented forces S2PIR_EL2 to zero on systems lacking EL3, causing an infinite loop of stage-2 permission faults under KVM with FEAT_S2PIE.
In ftgmac100_insert_vlan(), declaring the vlan_tci parameter as uint8_t truncates the 16-bit VLAN tag from the transmit descriptor, corrupting egress VLAN IDs and priority fields.

In hw/audio/hda-codec.c, the codec initialization functions invert the sense of the mixer property check, disabling mixer emulation when mixer=on is configured and causing audio streams to start muted.

In target/s390x/tcg/translate.c, op_clc() overwrites cc_src with the first operand before attempting to load the second operand, leaving cc_src corrupted if loading the second operand raises a memory access fault.

In inflate_buffer(), treating Z_STREAM_END as a non-terminating case in the decompression loop prevents the loop from exiting when valid compressed data contains trailing bytes, causing an infinite loop.

In read_sstatus(), computing the SD status bit using riscv_cpu_mxl() instead of riscv_cpu_sxl() causes the status register to be formatted with the 64-bit machine width instead of the 32-bit supervisor width.
In helper_raise_exception(), raising an exception under icount mode without adjusting the PMU instruction counter causes unretired instructions such as ECALL to be erroneously counted in minstret.
In riscv_cpu_dump_state(), printing env->gpr[i] with PRIx64 instead of a zero-padded hex format omits leading zeros, corrupting column alignment in register state dumps.

In hw/block/m25p80.c, decode routines for Spansion flash fast read commands treat the CR2V dummy clock cycle count as a byte count, causing the flash model to delay entry into the data phase by the wrong number of transfer bytes.

In hw/block/m25p80.c, decode_fast_read_cmd() and decode_qio_read_cmd() assign excessive dummy byte counts for Winbond flash chips, causing the model to wait for extra dummy bytes and drop valid read data.

In cpu_physical_memory_sync_dirty_bitmap(), the 64-bit range fastpath clears dirty bitmap bits without invoking cpu_physical_memory_dirty_bits_cleared(), allowing subsequent writes through cached TCG TLB entries to bypass dirty tracking and corrupt guest memory during migration.
In tcg_dump_ops(), checking name for non-NULL rather than non-empty in bswap_flag_name causes unnamed bswap flags to be printed as empty strings instead of their hexadecimal values.

In tcg_gen_hswap_i64() (tcg/tcg-op.c), gen_bitswap_i64() is invoked with the destination operand ret instead of the source operand arg, causing the 64-bit halfword swap operation to read uninitialized or stale register data when ret and arg differ.
In vfio_connect_kvm_msi_virq(), failing to verify that vector->use is set before loading CPR vector file descriptors causes a NULL pointer dereference and segmentation fault during snapshot loading.

In target/arm/tcg/translate.c, trans_SEV() checks for ARM_FEATURE_V7 instead of ARM_FEATURE_V6K, causing the SEV instruction to execute as a NOP on ARMv6K cores and hanging kernel boot on multi-core processors like ARM11MPCore.

In nvme_do_copy(), allocating the bounce buffer using only the source namespace metadata size causes a heap buffer overflow during cross-namespace copies when the destination namespace requires additional protection information metadata.

In nvme_exit(), unconditionally attempting to remove n->iomem as a subregion of n->bar0 triggers an assertion failure in memory_region_del_subregion() when hot-unplugging a controller configured with an MSI-X exclusive BAR.
In vhost_commit(), encountering a stale or invalid vring address mapping during memory listener updates calls abort(), terminating the QEMU process instead of signaling a device error.

In hw/display/virtio-gpu.c, distinguishing blob resources by checking whether blob_size is non-zero misclassifies valid empty blob resources as 2D resources, corrupting cursor updates and migration serialization.
In ide_dma_cb(), asserting that prepare_buf() returns a non-negative value causes an assertion failure and crashes QEMU when buffer preparation fails on malformed guest PRD tables.
In vfio_user_device_io_set_irqs(), adding sizeof(VFIOUserHdr) to irq->argsz without overflow checking allows an integer overflow to allocate an undersized message buffer.
In vfio_user_device_io_device_feature(), evaluating sizeof(VFIOUserHdr) + feature->argsz without overflow checking can result in an integer overflow, allocating an undersized request buffer.

In vfio_user_get_region_info(), adding sizeof(VFIOUserHdr) to info->argsz without integer overflow validation allows an integer overflow to allocate an undersized buffer, causing a heap buffer overflow.

In virtio_gpu_load() and virtio_gpu_blob_load(), allocating res->addrs and res->iov using g_new() with an unbounded iov_cnt from the migration stream causes a process abort when memory allocation fails.
In virtio_gpu_init_udmabuf(), returning early when virtio_gpu_remap_udmabuf() fails omits calling virtio_gpu_destroy_udmabuf(), leaking the allocated dmabuf file descriptor.

In s390_get_subregion(), failing to check for integer overflow in offset + len and verify that the range resides within the BAR memory region bounds allows out-of-bounds memory accesses during s390x PCI instruction emulation.

In initialize_debug_host() within disas/disas-host.c, referencing the obsolete Capstone macro CS_ARCH_SYSZ instead of CS_ARCH_SYSTEMZ causes compilation failures on s390x hosts when compiling against Capstone v6.

In sclp_service_call_protected() within hw/s390x/sclp.c, copying memory back to the guest with the length field from work_sccb instead of the original allocated header length causes an out-of-bounds heap read when an SCLP command execution callback increases the header length field.

In hw/core/machine.c, registering the x-migrate-fetch-addr-64bit compatibility properties for sysbus-ehci-usb and pci-ehci-usb in hw_compat_11_0 instead of hw_compat_11_1 associates the compatibility flags with the wrong machine version, breaking backward live migration compatibility for version 11.1 machines.

In qdev_realize() within hw/core/qdev.c, attaching an unparented device to its parent bus before assigning it a QOM parent leaves the device stranded on the bus without a parent if realization fails (causing bus_unparent() to spin indefinitely), while asserting !dev->realized triggers an assertion abort if a device is realized via property assignment.

In esdhc_write() within hw/sd/sdhci.c, applying uSDHC-specific ESDHC_MIX_CTRL and SDHC_TRNMOD register translation quirks to standard eSDHC devices corrupts transfer mode register writes on systems where the guest driver expects the standard SDHC interface, causing filesystem corruption on machines such as i.MX53 and e500.

In linux-user/syscall.c and linux-user/strace.c, guarding fsopen and related mount syscall implementations with NR_fsopen instead of __NR_fsopen, along with omitting checks for FSCONFIG_SET_FLAG, causes build failures when compiling QEMU against newer kernel headers or older distribution libc headers.

In rng_backend_request_entropy() within backends/rng.c, allocating memory with g_malloc() directly sized by the guest-controlled request length without an upper bound allows a malicious guest to trigger multi-gigabyte allocation requests that abort QEMU.

In virtio_queue_set_num() within hw/virtio/virtio.c, failing to validate the guest-requested queue size against the queue's default allocated capacity allows the guest to set a size exceeding the allocated used_elems buffer, leading to heap out-of-bounds memory accesses when VIRTIO_F_IN_ORDER is enabled.

In receive_filter() within hw/net/virtio-net.c, reading Ethernet and VLAN header fields without verifying that the received packet meets the minimum required packet length leads to out-of-bounds memory reads when processing unpadded short network frames.

In virtio_set_features_nocheck() within hw/virtio/virtio.c, forwarding raw guest-supplied feature bits to set_features_ex() without masking them against host_features_ex allows a guest to enable features not supported by the host, triggering subsequent out-of-bounds memory reads in device models such as virtio-net.

In css_schid_final() (hw/s390x/css.c), the size parameter passed to find_last_bit() is divided by sizeof(unsigned long) rather than specified in bits, prematurely reporting subchannel IDs beyond 8192 as final and halting device discovery.

In v9fs_open() within hw/9pfs/9p.c, checking read-only permissions by testing Linux open flag bits against the wire protocol mode argument instead of the converted flags variable allows 9p2000.u clients opening files with O_TRUNC to bypass read-only enforcement and truncate files on read-only exports.

In mode_select_pages() within hw/scsi/scsi-disk.c, permitting truncated mode pages under the Macintosh compatibility quirk without clamping page_len to the actual remaining buffer length causes scsi_disk_check_mode_select() and scsi_disk_apply_mode_select() to read beyond the end of the input buffer.

In sd_read_data() within hw/sd/sd.c, returning dummy_byte (0) instead of the transferred byte length when a CMD18 read address is out of range violates the read_data contract, causing an assertion failure or infinite loop in sdbus_read_data().

In gic_icc_apr_el1_write() within target/arm/tcg/gicv5-cpuif.c, updating the active priority register ICC_APR_EL1 without calling gicv5_update_irq_fiq() fails to re-evaluate CPU running priority and pending interrupts, causing IRQ and FIQ outputs to become stale.

In gicr_cdia_read() within target/arm/tcg/gicv5-cpuif.c, declaring ppibit as uint32_t instead of uint64_t causes 1ULL << (id % 64) to be truncated to zero for PPI IDs 32 through 63, preventing state updates and acknowledgment for those interrupts.

In usb_xhci_pci_exit() within hw/usb/hcd-xhci-pci.c, failing to unrealize the embedded xhci-core child and clear its strong host link back to the PCI device leaves a reference count cycle, preventing device_finalize() from running and causing a memory leak upon device unplug.

In virtio_gpu_do_set_scanout() and virtio_gpu_scanout_blob_to_fb() within hw/display/virtio-gpu.c, failing to validate that the framebuffer stride is at least width * bytes_pp allows a guest to specify a small stride with a large width, causing pixman to read out of bounds from the heap and leak host memory to the display.

In build_spcr() within hw/acpi/aml-build.c, emitting the Language field before the Terminal Type field in the Serial Port Console Redirection table violates the ACPI specification, producing invalid SPCR tables on LoongArch and RISC-V virtual machines.

In ebpf_rss_set_all() within ebpf/ebpf_rss.c, passing indirections_table and toeplitz_key in inverted order to trace_ebpf_rss_set_data() causes the two pointers to be swapped and mislabeled in generated trace event logs.

In pca955x_get_led() and pca955x_set_led() within hw/gpio/pca9552.c, an off-by-one check condition (led > k->pin_count instead of >=) accepts an LED index equal to pin_count, causing an out-of-bounds register array access when indexing LED selector registers.

In rpcit_service_call() within hw/s390x/s390-pci-inst.c, omitting validation for integer overflow in the requested address range and failing to clamp the range to the registered IOAT aperture causes QEMU to unnecessarily walk unregistered table entries and report spurious translation errors.

In vfio_listener_region_del() within hw/vfio/listener.c, assigning the guest physical address directly to entry.translated_addr instead of calculating the RAM block address causes physical_memory_set_dirty_lebitmap() to index beyond the dirty memory bitmap and crash when unmapping high-GPA RAM sections during dirty tracking.

In hvf_arch_init_vcpu() within target/arm/hvf/hvf.c, marking ID_AA64ISAR0_EL1 as ARM_CP_NO_RAW while leaving it in the HVF system register list triggers an assertion failure aborting QEMU when initializing vCPUs with HVF acceleration on Apple Silicon.

In vtd_cap_init() within hw/i386/intel_iommu.c, setting the pass-through capability flag VTD_ECAP_PT in the standard capability register (s->cap) rather than the extended capability register (s->ecap) corrupts capability register bits and prevents guest OS detection of IOMMU pass-through support.

In amdvi_build_xt_msi_msg() within hw/i386/amd_iommu.c, relying on a bitfield union (union mmio_xt_intr) to parse the guest XT interrupt control MMIO register causes incorrect field decoding on big-endian hosts, while failing to initialize the X86IOMMUIrq struct passes uninitialized stack fields to MSI conversion.

In hw/display/virtio-gpu.c, virtio_gpu_find_check_resource() conflates backing storage verification with resource host representation checks, causing valid virtio_gpu_set_scanout commands lacking backing storage to fail and improperly accepting invalid blob resource configurations.

In read_vtype() within target/riscv/csr.c, reading the vtype CSR from a TCG plugin vcpu_init_cb() callback before env->xl has been initialized hits a g_assert_not_reached() abort because env->xl is zero.

In v9fs_xattrwalk() and v9fs_xattrcreate() within hw/9pfs/9p.c, the absence of an upper bound on concurrently open xattr FIDs allows a malicious guest to allocate arbitrarily many xattr value buffers and exhaust host memory.
In ui/console.c, creating gl_unblock_timer inside qemu_graphic_console_create() rather than during qemu_console_init() causes the timer to be reallocated and leaked whenever a console is recycled.

In qemu_graphic_console_close() within ui/console.c, failing to delete con->ui_timer before resetting console hardware operations causes a pending UI timer to fire against reset ops, leading to a null pointer dereference crash.

In sdl2_window_create() within ui/sdl2.c, omitting the SDL_GL_CONTEXT_PROFILE_ES attribute setting when OpenGL ES mode is selected causes SDL to load desktop OpenGL instead of GLES, triggering an epoxy assertion failure crash.

In qemu_pixman_image_new_shareable() within ui/qemu-pixman.c, failing to compute the row stride when rowstride_bytes is passed as zero produces a zero-size buffer allocation request that causes qemu_memfd_alloc() to abort.

In v9fs_wstat() within hw/9pfs/9p.c, failing to validate the destination name against '.' and '..' in Twstat rename requests allows invalid directory reference renames to reach the host filesystem backend instead of being rejected with -EISDIR.

In parse_hexstr() within hw/uefi/var-service-json.c, a loop condition of i < len while consuming two hex characters per iteration causes an out-of-bounds read on the source string and a one-byte buffer overflow in the destination buffer when the input length is odd.

In pci_setup_iommu_per_bus() within hw/pci/pci.c, failing to verify whether bus->iommu_per_bus is already configured allows multiple SMMUv3 devices to be attached to the same PCI bus, silently overwriting earlier IOMMU ops without an error.

In create_fdt_pcie() within hw/riscv/virt.c, generating the PCIe iommu-map property with an extraneous zero-length tuple and passing 0xffff instead of 0x10000 as the mapping size excludes Requester ID 0xffff from IOMMU translation in the guest.

In target/riscv/cpu.h, placing the Smrnmi CSR fields below the CPU reset line in CPUArchState prevents them from being cleared during CPU reset, leaving stale register values in the vCPU after a reset.

In aspeed_2700_i2c_class_init() within hw/i2c/aspeed_i2c.c, configuring the AST2700 I2C buffer pool size as 0x20 at offset 0x1a0 instead of 0x40 at offset 0x1c0 causes buffer mode transfers to fail against AST2700 hardware firmware definitions.

In riscv_cpu_init() within target/riscv/cpu.c, reallocating a global general_user_opts hash table on each CPU initialization leaks previously allocated tables and causes CPU option settings to collide across multiple vCPUs.

In hw/i386/pc.c, instantiating the PC speaker device during pc_machine_initfn() without releasing its reference in a machine finalizer leaks the pcspk device object if the machine is destroyed before realization.

In char_socket_get_addr() within chardev/char-socket.c, invoking visit_type_SocketAddress() on s->addr without verifying that it is non-NULL causes an assertion failure or crash when querying the addr property on unrealized or disconnected socket chardevs.

In virtio-gpu virgl scanout handling (hw/display/virtio-gpu-virgl.c), guest scanout dimensions are forwarded to console resizing without bounds or wraparound checks, allowing a guest to trigger host termination via error_abort in qemu_pixman_image_new_shareable().

In hw/ide/macio.c, pmac_ide_atapi_transfer_cb() and pmac_ide_transfer_cb() invoke dma_memory_unmap() with an uninitialized NULL buffer pointer, triggering assertion failures and memory region reference leaks in bounce buffer handling.

In hw/pci/pci.c, do_pci_register_device() executes the function 0 occupancy check only when devfn >= 0, skipping the verification when devfn is automatically assigned (< 0) and improperly permitting secondary function hotplug after function 0 is populated.

In system/physmem.c, dirty_memory_extend() calculates previous block counts from active RAMBlocks via last_ram_page() rather than tracking allocated block counts, losing references to existing dirty memory bitmap blocks and leaking host memory when RAMBlocks are removed and added.

In target/hppa/cpu.h, hppa_form_gva_psw() returns the raw instruction address without masking it via gva_offset_mask(psw) under CONFIG_USER_ONLY, causing 32-bit user-space programs on 64-bit HPPA to access unmasked 64-bit addresses and crash.

In target/hppa/helper.c, cpu_hppa_get_psw() checks env->psw_v < 0 (bit 63) instead of bit 31 to package the PSW V-bit, causing the overflow flag to be lost across interrupts on 64-bit HPPA and corrupting division in the guest Linux kernel.
In migration/multifd-uadk.c, multifd_uadk_send_cleanup() fails to free p->iov allocated during multifd_uadk_send_setup(), causing a memory leak whenever a UADK multifd migration session terminates.

In blockdev-nbd.c, nbd_server_free() unreferences server->listener without resetting the pointer to NULL, allowing subsequent client closure callbacks to access the freed listener via nbd_update_server_watch() and trigger a use-after-free.

In system/vl.c, select_machine() references optarg instead of machine_type when reporting unknown machine errors, printing (null), and deletes the type entry from qdict before formatting the error, creating a dangling pointer.
In migration/multifd.c, multifd_recv_cleanup_channel() does not free p->data, leaking the MultiFDRecvData structures allocated for each multifd receive channel upon migration teardown.

In virtio_pci_get_notifier() (hw/virtio/virtio-pci.c), failing to check whether proxy->vector_irqfd is NULL when VIRTIO_CONFIG_S_DRIVER_OK is set allows guest vector configuration on devices lacking guest notifiers (such as virtio-input) to trigger a NULL pointer dereference in kvm_virtio_pci_vq_vector_use().

In virtio_snd_set_pcm_params() (hw/audio/virtio-snd.c), comparing the bitmask BIT(params->format) against the byte size sizeof(supported_formats) instead of the bit width rejects valid stream formats and permits out-of-bounds bit shifts when format or rate IDs exceed 63.

In access_ptr() (target/i386/tcg/access.c), failing to return NULL when ac->haddr1 is unpopulated allows TCG plugin-instrumented memory accesses using TLB_MMIO slow paths to perform pointer arithmetic on NULL and crash the emulator with a segmentation fault.

In scsi_block_sgio_complete() (hw/scsi/scsi-disk.c), handling SCSI errors directly via scsi_handle_rw_error() bypasses the completion callback and leaves r->req.aiocb non-NULL, triggering an assertion failure in scsi_read_data() or scsi_write_data() upon VM resume after an I/O stop action.

In sd_read_byte() (hw/sd/sd.c), attempting to read DAT lines while the SD card is in an invalid command state hits a g_assert_not_reached() abort instead of logging a guest error and returning dummy data, allowing a malicious guest to crash QEMU.

In hvf_sysreg_read() (target/arm/hvf/hvf.c), passing the address of the pointer &val instead of val to hvf_sysreg_read_cp() overwrites the local pointer variable on the stack instead of writing to the target register buffer.

In virtio_net_has_buffers() (hw/net/virtio-net.c), failing to repeatedly poll for newly added guest buffers after enabling notifications when available buffers remain insufficient causes the receive queue to miss subsequent kicks and permanently stall packet reception.

In x86_cpu_get_supported_feature_word() (target/i386/cpu.c), declaring unavail as uint32_t causes r &= ~unavail to zero out the upper 32 bits of the 64-bit feature word r, incorrectly stripping supported CPUID and VMX feature flags.

In hw/ppc/spapr.c and hw/ppc/spapr_caps.c, the SPAPR machine VMState definition omits the vmstate_spapr_cap_ail_mode_3 subsection, causing migration state mismatches and migration failure when ail-mode-3 is modified via the command line.

In helper_lddir() (target/loongarch/tcg/tlb_helper.c), attempting to write a level value of 4 into the 2-bit LEVEL field of TLBENTRY when encountering level-4 huge pages causes bitfield overflow and corrupts neighboring bits in the TLB entry.

In hw/intc/loongson_ipi.c, allocating s->cpu in loongson_ipi_realize() but only freeing it in loongson_ipi_finalize() causes a memory leak whenever the device is realized and unrealized multiple times before destruction.

In vfio_connect_container() (hw/vfio/container.c), calling QLIST_REMOVE(bcontainer, next) on the listener_release_exit error label results in a double list removal and crash when vfio_container_instance_finalize() subsequently removes the container again.

In hw_compat_9_0 (hw/core/machine.c), applying the migrate-emulated-scsi-request compatibility property to scsi-disk-base causes QEMU to abort when introspecting derived devices like scsi-block that do not define this property.

In sgx_epc_get_section() (hw/i386/sgx.c), unconditionally casting qdev_get_machine() to PCMachineState without validating the machine type causes an assertion failure or NULL pointer dereference when querying SGX CPUID leaves on non-PC platforms such as microvm.
In nvme_dsm_cb() (hw/nvme/ctrl.c), completing or aborting a Dataset Management command fails to free iocb->range, leaking host heap memory on every executed DSM request.

In vub_discard_write_zeroes() (contrib/vhost-user-blk/vhost-user-blk.c), left-shifting the 32-bit desc->num_sectors value by 9 bits before casting to uint64_t causes integer overflow when discarding or zeroing ranges of 4GB or greater.

In struct VTDIOTLBPageInvInfo (hw/i386/intel_iommu_internal.h), defining the mask field as uint8_t causes integer truncation when invalidating pages with an address mask greater than 8, preventing matching IOTLB entries from being flushed.

In smmu_ptw_64_s2() and smmuv3_translate() (hw/arm/smmu-common.c, hw/arm/smmuv3.c), failing to store the faulting IPA in ptw_info.addr causes stage-2 translation event records to omit the required intermediate physical address.

In create_fdt_one_aplic() (hw/riscv/virt.c), renaming the devicetree property riscv,delegate to riscv,delegation broke compatibility with existing AIA-capable guest firmwares that rely on the legacy property name, causing them to fail during boot.

In vfio_display_edid_init() (hw/vfio/display.c), failing to report errors to errp when reading GFX EDID fields fails allows display initialization to succeed silently with an uninitialized EDID configuration.

In hiod_legacy_vfio_get_iova_ranges() and hiod_iommufd_vfio_get_iova_ranges() (hw/vfio/container.c, hw/vfio/iommufd.c), performing a shallow g_list_copy() on bcontainer->iova_ranges causes double-free heap corruption when both the caller and container finalizer invoke g_list_free_full().

In virtio_device_should_start() (include/hw/virtio/virtio.h), querying virtio_device_started() causes the function to return true when vdev->started is set even if status is 0, causing vhost-user de-initialization routines to be skipped during device unplug.

In vhost_user_blk_disconnect(), vhost_user_scsi_disconnect(), and vub_disconnect() (hw/block/vhost-user-blk.c, hw/scsi/vhost-user-scsi.c, hw/virtio/vhost-user-base.c), returning early when s->connected is false skips re-registering chardev event handlers, preventing the device from ever reconnecting to the vhost backend after a failed connection attempt.

In virtio_pci_bus_reset_hold() (hw/virtio/virtio-pci.c), writing zero to PCI_PM_CTRL unconditionally clobbers read-only capability bits such as NO_SOFT_RESET and improperly resets power management state when VIRTIO_PCI_FLAG_INIT_PM is not set.

In create_fdt_one_imsic() (hw/riscv/virt.c), generating device tree node names in the form imsics@<addr> instead of interrupt-controller@<addr> violates the Linux RISC-V IMSIC devicetree specification.

In file_start_outgoing_migration() (migration/file.c), opening the migration file with O_TRUNC unconditionally erases data preceding the specified migration offset, corrupting pre-existing headers written by management software using fdsets.
In sev_get_capabilities() (target/i386/sev.c), failing to return NULL after setting an error when sev_common is NULL leads to an immediate NULL pointer dereference in object_property_get_str().

In sev_encrypt_flash() (target/i386/sev.c), calling SEV_COMMON_GET_CLASS(sev_common) before checking whether sev_common is NULL causes a NULL pointer dereference crash when flashing memory without SEV enabled.

In BDRVCopyBeforeWriteState (block/copy-before-write.c), declaring cbw_timeout_ns as uint32_t causes integer overflow for any timeout exceeding 4 seconds, causing copy-before-write operations to time out almost immediately.

In xlnx_dpdma_read_descriptor() (hw/dma/xlnx_dpdma.c), passing &desc instead of desc to dma_memory_read() reads 64 bytes of descriptor data into an 8-byte stack pointer variable, causing a stack buffer overflow.

In virtio_net_load_ebpf_fds() and virtio_net_load_ebpf() (hw/net/virtio-net.c), propagating file descriptor load errors to errp causes virtio-net realization to fail and leak allocated memory instead of warning and falling back to built-in eBPF loading.

In ricsv_gen_dynamic_vector_feature() (target/riscv/gdbstub.c), assigning byte length vlenb rather than bit length vlenb << 3 to the register size causes QEMU to declare vector registers to GDB with only 1/8th of their true bit width.

In raise_mmu_exception() (target/riscv/cpu_helper.c), evaluating two-stage guest page faults before checking pmp_violation causes Physical Memory Protection access faults to be misreported as guest page faults under two-stage translation.

In target/riscv/kvm/kvm-cpu.c, exposing the RISC-V Zkr extension to KVM guests without emulating the SEED CSR causes either an unhandled exit crash in QEMU or an illegal instruction crash in the guest kernel during boot.

In io/channel-tls.c and io/channel-websock.c, wrapper I/O channels fail to inherit follow_coroutine_ctx from the underlying master channel, triggering an assertion failure in qio_channel_restart_read() when NBD runs with TLS across iothread coroutine contexts.

In target/s390x/helper.h, declaring helper_per_ifetch with TCG_CALL_NO_RWG prevents TCG from saving and synchronizing global CPU registers to memory before the helper accesses CPU state during instruction-fetch exceptions.

In kvm_hv_handle_exit() (target/i386/kvm/hyperv.c), returning 0 instead of EXCP_INTERRUPT for KVM_EXIT_HYPERV_SYNIC allows the vCPU to resume guest execution before async_synic_update() finishes running, causing subsequent SINT route creation to fail due to uninitialized SynIC state.

In vfio_display_dmabuf_init() and vfio_display_region_init() (hw/vfio/display.c), failing to check if ramfb_setup() returns NULL causes the functions to return success while errp is set, triggering an assertion failure in error_setv().

In adapter_info_so_needed() (hw/intc/s390_flic.c), casting opaque to S390FLICState via S390_FLIC_COMMON() triggers a QOM assertion failure or memory corruption during VM migration because the callback is attached to a VirtioCcwBusState.

In gd_motion_event() (ui/gtk.c), multiplying cursor motion coordinates by gtk_widget_get_scale_factor() after switching to widget-relative dimensions causes double scaling of mouse movements on HiDPI displays.

In loongarch_init() (hw/loongarch/virt.c), heap memory allocated by g_strdup_printf() for ramName in the NUMA node initialization loop is never freed, leaking host memory on multi-node configurations.

In encode_topo_cpuid8000001e() (target/i386/cpu.c), encoding dies_per_pkg - 1 into the 3-bit NodesPerProcessor field of CPUID Fn8000001E_ECX overflows into reserved bits when more than 8 dies are configured, causing SEV-SNP guest boot to fail.

In _decode_opc() (target/sh4/translate.c), the TCG translation for the SH4 SUBV instruction computes the underflow T-flag using Result ^ Rm instead of Result ^ Rn, causing incorrect condition flag updates on arithmetic underflow.

In whpx_init_vcpu() (target/i386/whpx/whpx-all.c), accessing cpu->accel->dirty before assigning the newly allocated vcpu structure to cpu->accel causes an immediate NULL pointer dereference crash during vCPU initialization.
In nvmm_init_vcpu() (target/i386/nvmm/nvmm-all.c), accessing cpu->accel->dirty prior to assigning qcpu to cpu->accel causes an immediate NULL pointer dereference crash during vCPU initialization.

In colo_incoming_co() (migration/colo.c), calling bdrv_activate_all() from within a coroutine context violates block graph locking constraints, triggering an assertion failure in bdrv_graph_rdlock_main_loop().

In virtio_gpu_scanout_blob_to_fb() (hw/display/virtio-gpu.c), calculating the framebuffer offset with 32-bit arithmetic results in integer overflow wraparound, allowing guest scanouts to bypass bounds checks and point to arbitrary memory locations.

In virtio_pci_common_write() (hw/virtio/virtio-pci.c), directly assigning the configuration vector without updating KVM irqfd routes when VIRTIO_CONFIG_S_DRIVER_OK is set leaves vector irqfds uninitialized, triggering an assertion failure in kvm_irqchip_commit_routes().

In fuse_co_init() (block/export/fuse.c), omitting the FUSE_ATOMIC_O_TRUNC capability flag for non-growable exports causes the kernel to execute truncations on open, leading to ENOTSUP failures on block device exports and stuck zero-length files.

In handle_pending_signal() (linux-user/signal.c), swapping k->info in place via tswap_siginfo() before logging signal details strips internal si_type metadata, triggering an abort in print_siginfo() when strace is enabled.

In gt_cntpoff_access() within target/arm/helper.c, EL2 accesses to CNTPOFF_EL2 with SCR_EL3.ECVEn unset return CP_ACCESS_TRAP_EL3 without checking whether EL3 is implemented. On CPU configurations lacking EL3, this triggers an assertion failure and abort in access_check_cp_reg() when executing EL2 guest code.

In raspi4b_machine_class_init() within hw/arm/raspi4b.c, the machine class unconditionally configures 2 GB of RAM across all host architectures. On 32-bit hosts where contiguous host memory allocation is restricted to 2047 MB, starting the machine or running qtests fails due to memory allocation exhaustion.

In postcopy_start() within migration/migration.c, several error exit paths fail without setting the errp parameter. Callers attempting to format and log the migration failure dereference an unset NULL error object, causing a segmentation fault.

In migration_completion() within migration/migration.c, failure during completion handling fails to record the migration error state via migrate_set_error(). Consequently, close_return_path_on_source() assumes no error occurred and omits the channel shutdown call, causing source migration to hang indefinitely waiting for the return-path thread to terminate.

In register_power10_dexcr_sprs() within target/ppc/cpu_init.c, the 64-bit SPRs DEXCR and HDEXCR are registered with the 32-bit write helper spr_write_generic32 instead of a 64-bit write callback. Register writes from the guest silently truncate the upper 32 bits, corrupting execution control settings.

In target_shmat() within linux-user/mmap.c, when host page size differs from guest page size and shmaddr is NULL without reserved_va, the anonymous mapping helper applies MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE to an address range already reserved by mmap_find_vma(). The host kernel rejects the mapping with EEXIST, causing guest shmat(NULL) syscalls to fail.

In print_ipc() within linux-user/strace.c, the arguments dispatched to print_shmat() are shifted off-by-one because arg1 holds the multiplexed IPCOP_shmat opcode rather than the first system call argument. System call tracing with -strace prints corrupted argument values for shmat.

In print_ipc() within linux-user/strace.c, the arguments for IPCOP_semctl are shifted off-by-one because arg1 contains the IPC multiplexer operation code rather than the semaphore identifier. Logging semctl invocations with -strace displays erroneous parameter values and memory addresses.

In clock_mux_update() within hw/misc/stm32l4x5_rcc.c, the return value of clock_set_mul_div() is ignored, so the change notification flag is not updated when only the clock multiplier or divider changes without an input frequency shift. Downstream clocks in the clock tree fail to receive updated clock periods.

In vhost_vdpa_device_start() within hw/virtio/vdpa-dev.c, virtqueues are enabled after setting the DRIVER_OK device status flag rather than before. This violates VDUSE kernel interface requirements where userspace cannot detect post-start virtqueue enablement, breaking VDUSE device operation.

In aspeed_soc_ast1030_class_init() within hw/arm/aspeed_ast10x0.c, the ast1030-a1 SoC device class omits setting dc->user_creatable = false. Attempting to instantiate the SoC via the -device command-line option aborts QEMU with an assertion failure.

In migration_iteration_run() within migration/migration.c, checking must_precopy <= s->threshold_size to trigger an exact dirty-page synchronization always evaluates to true when postcopy is enabled, because RAM reporting treats all pages as postcopy-capable and sets must_precopy to zero. This triggers an expensive full dirty-bitmap synchronization on every iteration, severely degrading migration throughput.

In do_inject_x86_mce() within target/i386/helper.c, monitor_puts(params->mon, msg) is invoked without verifying that params->mon is non-NULL. When MCE injection occurs outside an interactive monitor session, dereferencing the NULL monitor pointer causes a segmentation fault.

In aspeed_smc_reset() within hw/ssi/aspeed_smc.c, the controller reset logic assumes every child device attached to the SPI bus is a flash device providing the SSI_GPIO_CS line and queries it directly. Connecting a non-flash device without this GPIO pin causes an assertion failure and aborts QEMU.

In x86_cpu_mmu_index() and cpu_mmu_index_kernel() within target/i386/cpu.c and target/i386/cpu.h, the boolean expressions determining mmu_index_32 invert the condition tests for HF_CS64_MASK and HF_LMA_MASK. 64-bit execution modes are assigned a 32-bit MMU index while 32-bit modes receive a 64-bit index, causing TLB conflicts and incorrect address masking above 4 GB.

In external_snapshot_abort() within blockdev.c, formatting the error message for a missing medium passes the device parameter directly, which is NULL when the snapshot targets a node by node-name. This results in either an invalid error message displaying (null) or a segmentation fault on platforms with strict printf format handling.

In nbd/server.c, client->nb_requests is incremented inside nbd_trip() after the request coroutine is created rather than before spawning it in nbd_client_receive_next_request(). A draining sequence checking nb_requests == 0 can complete prematurely while a coroutine is already assigned to client->recv_coroutine, triggering an assertion failure when switching AioContexts.

In block/mirror.c, mirror_iteration() executes while holding the coroutine graph reader lock (bdrv_graph_co_rdlock()) and reaches job_pause_point(). When a concurrent operation attempts to acquire the graph writer lock (bdrv_graph_wrlock()), it drains the mirror job, which remains paused with the reader lock held, deadlocking both coroutines.

In file_start_incoming_migration() and fd_start_incoming_migration() within migration/file.c and migration/fd.c, error paths during multifd setup fail to release allocated QIOChannel objects and GSource watches. An extra channel is also allocated needlessly and left unreferenced on failure.

In init_blk_migration() within migration/block.c, encountering an empty block device where bdrv_nb_sectors() returns zero aborts the device iteration loop entirely instead of advancing to the next entry. Any subsequent non-empty block devices in the system are skipped and excluded from migration.

In include/hw/cxl/cxl_pci.h, the CXLDVSECDevice structure definition omits a 2-byte reserved padding field present in the CXL r3.1 specification, making the structure smaller than PCIE_CXL_DEVICE_DVSEC_LENGTH. Memory operations that read or write DVSEC data using the defined length overrun the structure buffer.

In build_hmat_lb() within hw/acpi/hmat.c, indexing into entry_list multiplies the raw initiator NUMA node ID rather than its compacted index in initiator_list. In sparse NUMA topologies where node IDs exceed the count of active initiators, calculated offsets exceed array boundaries and cause out-of-bounds heap writes.

In nvme_sriov_pre_write_ctrl() within hw/nvme/ctrl.c, the controller reads PCI_SRIOV_NUM_VF directly from guest-writable PCI configuration space to index n->sec_ctrl_list.sec[]. A malicious guest can provide an out-of-range value or modify the register without enabling VFs, inducing an out-of-bounds heap buffer access.

In nvme_realize() within hw/nvme/ctrl.c, virtual functions duplicate the physical function's parameters via a shallow structure copy, sharing the allocated params.serial string pointer. When a virtual function is unplugged, property destruction frees the shared string, leaving the physical function with a dangling pointer that triggers a use-after-free upon instantiating subsequent virtual functions.

In ebus_realize() within hw/sparc64/sun4u.c, BAR0 is mapped as an alias to PCI IO space rather than an unassigned IO memory region. During OpenBSD kernel startup, probing unpopulated offsets within the BAR triggers unhandled PCI bus memory faults, preventing the guest kernel from completing initialization.

In qemu_rdma_accept() within migration/rdma.c, the socket address host field isock->host is assigned the borrowed pointer rdma->host without duplicating the string. When isock is subsequently deallocated via qapi_free_InetSocketAddress(), the shared pointer is freed, resulting in a use-after-free or double-free and migration failure.

In grlib_irqmp_realize() within hw/intc/grlib_irqmp.c, when irqmp->ncpus is out of the valid range, an error message is set via error_setg() but the function fails to return. Device realization continues in an invalid configuration, attaching GPIO interrupts for out-of-bounds CPU counts.

In qmp_block_resize() within blockdev.c, encountering an op blocker causes error_setg() to format an error message referencing device, which is NULL when the target is specified by node_name. This discards the detailed blocker error message and emits a message displaying (null) or triggers a crash on platforms where printf faults on NULL strings.

In touch_all_pages() within util/oslib-posix.c, when single-threaded synchronous preallocation is selected, the function executes qemu_madvise() and returns immediately without freeing the previously allocated MemsetContext structure.

In get_physical_address() and riscv_cpu_reset_hold() within target/riscv/cpu_helper.c and target/riscv/cpu.c, hardware updating of page table entry A/D bits is not properly conditioned on svade and svadu extension state. Page table walks update access and dirty bits in memory even when svade is configured without svadu, where the architecture requires raising a page fault exception.

In exec_start_outgoing_migration() and exec_start_incoming_migration() within migration/exec.c, argv is declared with g_auto(GStrv) but contains borrowed strings from strList. To prevent g_strfreev() from double-freeing these borrowed strings, the pointer is cleared with g_steal_pointer(), which prevents the cleanup handler from executing and permanently leaks the outer array allocation.

In tcp_chr_read() within chardev/char-socket.c, when a TLS channel triggers a subsequent read attempt for pending buffered bytes, the function reuses the cached s->max_size value without re-querying frontend capacity via tcp_chr_read_poll(). Sending more bytes than the frontend can currently accept triggers assertion failures in frontends with fixed-size buffers, such as sclpconsole.

In fold_setcond_tst_pow2() within tcg/optimize.c, local opcode variables uext_opc and sext_opc are left uninitialized when host extract operations are invalid for the target. Subsequent logic reads these uninitialized variables, causing undefined behavior and emitting bogus opcodes or corrupted data into the TCG opcode stream.

In get_physical_address() within target/i386/tcg/sysemu/excp_helper.c, physical memory addresses are truncated to 32 bits whenever long mode is inactive (EFER.LMA == 0). This breaks 32-bit operating systems utilizing Physical Address Extension (PAE) to address memory above 4 GB, corrupting page table entry walks and causing system boot failures.

In is_prefix_insn_excp() within target/ppc/excp_helper.c, checking whether a faulting instruction is prefixed loads the instruction word from memory without checking if the exception was originally caused by an instruction fetch failure. Re-attempting to fetch an invalid instruction address causes a recursive machine check exception that crashes QEMU.

In pc_q35_init() within hw/i386/pc_q35.c, the LPC PCI function is realized before its GSI GPIO interrupt lines are connected. Sub-devices created during LPC realization, such as the MC146818 RTC, obtain a NULL interrupt handler (rtc->irq == NULL), preventing timer interrupts from reaching the guest.

In mps2_scc_read() within hw/misc/mps2-scc.c, the condition guarding against reading the reserved CFG3 register uses logical AND (scc_partno(s) == 0x524 && scc_partno(s) == 0x547) instead of logical OR. The compound condition is never true, permitting unauthorized register reads on AN524 and AN547 boards where CFG3 is reserved.

In hw/smbios/smbios.c, the qemu_smbios_type8_opts array omits the terminating empty sentinel element {} and the entry for the type parameter. When QemuOpts parses command-line -smbios type=8 options, it iterates beyond the end of the array into unrelated memory.

In hw/smbios/smbios.c, the qemu_smbios_type11_opts array omits the terminating empty sentinel element {} and the entry for the type parameter. When QemuOpts processes -smbios type=11 options, it reads past the array bounds into adjacent data.

In mdev_reg_read() within hw/cxl/cxl-device-utils.c, the function returns a hardcoded status indicating media readiness rather than reading the stored register state, preventing the media disabled status from being reported during device sanitation. Additionally, __toggle_media() writes to an incorrect register offset, corrupting the reported mailbox size register.

In multifd_tls_channel_connect() within migration/multifd.c, the p->running flag is asserted before creating the worker thread, causing cleanup handlers to invoke qemu_thread_join() on uncreated threads if TLS handshaking fails. Furthermore, clearing p->running during thread exit races with multifd_send_cleanup(), which may destroy the channel mutex while still locked.

In multifd_tls_channel_connect() within migration/multifd.c, spawning the TLS handshake worker thread overwrites the channel's main p->thread handle. Because the joinable TLS thread handle is not tracked separately, multifd_send_terminate_threads() never joins it, leaking thread resources.

In memory_device_pre_plug() within hw/mem/memory-device.c, the check verifying that memory region size is a multiple of the region's alignment was removed. Memory devices can be plugged with arbitrary unaligned sizes (such as 1 GB + 1 byte) or sizes that do not align with hugetlb page sizes, leading to wasted memory and mapping errors.
In hmp_migrate() within migration/migration-hmp-cmds.c, encountering an error returned from qmp_migrate() causes the function to exit immediately without deallocating MigrationChannelList *caps.

In include/qemu/bswap.h, the const_le64 macro implementation for big-endian hosts uses 32-bit integer literals (...U) for byte masking. When evaluated with arguments of types smaller than 64 bits, the masked expressions produce 32-bit types, causing left shifts of 40 and 56 bits to exceed the type width and trigger compiler errors (-Werror=shift-count-overflow).

In handle_vec_simd_sqshrn() within target/arm/tcg/translate-a64.c, scalar signed saturating narrowing shifts move the raw sign-extended result into the destination register without masking off upper bits. When the narrowed result is negative, extraneous sign-extension bits remain in the register instead of being truncated to the element size.

In arm_deliver_fault() within target/arm/tcg/tlb_helper.c, the condition determining whether a fault is a VNCR access erroneously evaluates mmu_idx != MMU_INST_FETCH instead of checking the access_type parameter. Comparing an MMU index against an access type enum causes instruction aborts to be misclassified as VNCR data aborts and routed to EL2 with incorrect syndrome data.

In qapi/string-output-visitor.c, StringOutputVisitor emits <omitted> at start_struct() but fails to suppress subsequent visitor callbacks for struct fields. When a struct contains a nested list (such as iothread-vq-mapping with vqs), the visitor encounters a nested list and triggers an assertion failure asserting that nested lists are unsupported.

In load_elf() within include/hw/elf_ops.h, the loop variable j used to iterate across segments for data byte-swapping is typed as a signed 32-bit int. When loading an ELF segment exceeding 2 GB on 64-bit systems, incrementing j causes signed integer overflow, resulting in undefined behavior or infinite loops.

In virt_machine_class_init() within hw/arm/virt.c, 64-bit AArch64 CPU types are added to mc->valid_cpu_types without #ifdef TARGET_AARCH64 conditional compilation guards. In 32-bit emulator builds (qemu-system-arm), these uncompiled CPU classes resolve to NULL, causing valid CPU listings to print (null) entries and corrupting CPU type validation.
